qa.phone-review.exact-native-digest-bind: The adapter recomputes the native receipt digest and binds item source, digest, game, slot, completeness, and authority flags exactly.
qa.phone-review.shared-inbox-reuse: QA Lab receives the existing durable ReviewService; no parallel review store was added.
qa.phone-review.idempotent-open: Repeated opens of the same source and digest return the same open Review Inbox item.

qa.phone-review.latest-human-decision: Only the latest exact-digest vote with actorKind human can produce campaign input; identity remains unauthenticated.
qa.phone-review.five-field-campaign-inpu: The handoff derives exactly gameId, candidateDigest, decision, reviewedAt, and voluntaryHumanReview for the existing campaign builder.
qa.phone-review.note-redaction: Review notes remain in ReviewService and are absent from the QA handoff and campaign input.
qa.phone-review.incomplete-cannot-accept: An approve vote on an incomplete checklist deterministically maps to INCOMPLETE.

qa.phone-review.nonhuman-export-refusal: Machine, collective, and unknown latest decisions remain non-exportable.
qa.phone-review.proof-authority.none: Action and handoff truth keep physicalHardwareProven false.
qa.phone-review.warning-authority.none: Action and handoff truth keep warning closure and manifest mutation authority false.
qa.phone-review.human-usefulness-authori: The handoff keeps humanUsefulnessEstablished false and leaves the independent two-key route unchanged.

qa.phone-review.service-reload: Isolated selftests recreate both QA and Review services and recover the exact candidate review input.
qa.phone-review.read-route: A bounded GET route returns only digest-bound handoff state; opening remains a separately confirmed POST.

qa.phone-review.desktop-live-route: At 1280x720, a real local render showed the disabled-to-enabled transition, explicit open result, inbox item, and false authority flags without horizontal overflow.

qa.phone-review.real-human-decision: No actual person reviewed a phone candidate; deterministic votes are fixtures only.

qa.phone-observation.physical-session: The live route used an all-false incomplete fixture; no physical-phone behavior was claimed.

qa.phone-observation.human-usefulness: No voluntary human-usefulness outcome was supplied.
